# BCN.travel

> > Barcelona's local tour operator and DMC providing curated tours, group experiences, and corporate event services throughout Barcelona and Catalonia.

BCN.travel specializes in authentic Barcelona experiences including guided tours, team-building activities like Lego Workshops, food tours, and comprehensive destination management services. Founded by local experts Kim and Lionel Logchies, the company serves both leisure travelers and corporate clients with personalized itineraries and group logistics.

## Key Topics

- Barcelona tours and experiences
- Destination Management Company (DMC) services
- Corporate team-building activities
- Lego Workshop facilitated sessions
- Food tours and culinary experiences
- Local Barcelona guides
- Group transfers and transportation
- Park Güell tours
- Barcelona Bus Turistic
- Steel Donkey Bike Tours
- Barcelona Card
- Sightseeing experiences
- Airport transportation
- Corporate events and group activities
- Moco Museum Barcelona
